rules: Never package owner-private Home Base databases, continuity exports, personal archives, health records, contacts, private ancestry, or private projects in the retail APK/AAB.
Never seed a real person's private note, location, family record, or other personal data into the retail database.
Never bundle user-owned copyrighted scans or proprietary study notes without redistribution rights.
Scripture source bytes are never silently edited by commentary, red-letter annotations, Ademic Cantus, runes, Alexandria, or personal notes.
Customer-created content stays local unless the customer explicitly exports or shares it.
Unknown rights status is not permission to redistribute.
Promotion requires source verification, Android compilation, physical-device acceptance, persistence testing, rollback/export testing, and store/legal review.
note: V20 United is a private personal build. Public-store separation rules are retained only as historical safety boundaries; the user's personal library may be imported locally but must not be redistributed.
